Questions before layering

Are the two black necklaces the same length?

The retrieved descriptions give both a 30 cm base, but different extensions: 10 cm for B0F9YMXL4B and 8 cm for B0D9GWX6L6. Confirm the chosen variant; a shared base length does not establish the same fit or width.

Is the Fesciory black necklace leather or fabric?

We use fabric for B0D9GWX6L6, following the site owner's clarification on October 30, 2026. The listing body also describes fabric, although its material field says leather. Fiber composition has not been confirmed.

Are all four Tewiky chain styles included?

The listing describes measurements for four chain styles, but this review does not confirm that the selected combination includes all four. Check the variant name, packaging list and whether the chains can be worn separately.

Does the lariat length include the drop?

The source gives a 16.5-inch necklace and a 2-inch extension. It does not establish a separate drop measurement in the reviewed text, so we do not infer one from the picture.

Are the material claims tested by FUBAO?

No. Listing descriptions and the owner's fabric clarification are identified separately. Gold plating does not mean solid gold, and we make no independent waterproof, allergy-suitability or tarnish guarantee.

Product-page prices remain historical references from October 25, 2026, converted at ¥150 = US$1. AI-styled images do not establish physical measurements or included quantities. No orders or payments are accepted here.
